title: 🏡 Welcoming Indiranagar: A Beautiful New Chapter for the HUB Family!
content:
We are thrilled to officially open our doors in the vibrant heart of Indiranagar! This new Experience Centre isn't just a new location—it’s a warm, welcoming space where families will come together to see their dream homes come to life. 
A heartfelt welcome and best wishes to our passionate Indiranagar team stepping onto the floor today. Let’s create lasting memories, design stunning spaces, and celebrate every new home that joins HUB. Welcome to the family, Team Indiranagar!
